title: Android Editor crash in scoped storage code (analytics report)
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6.stable
- Reproducible in 4.5.2.rc1

### System information

Android 15 and 16 Beta on various devices

### Issue description

This is a copy of a Google Play crash report for the Godot Editor on Android after it was updated to 4.6.stable yesterday.

We don't have more info than just the stacktrace, so we have to work from that.

Report for maintainers with access: https://play.google.com/console/u/0/developers/5310120689138741555/app/4972363226496209566/vitals/crashes/eb0c82764112997ebd2d06469be288f4/details?days=28&isUserPerceived=true&versionCode=40600500

```

  at android.app.ActivityThread.performLaunchActivity (ActivityThread.java:4049)
```
